li.label: a door that sticks
li.description: That battered door sticks every time. Somebody ought to fix it before I take it off its hinges.

li.label: a leaking roof
li.description: There's a hole in the roof, and the weather knows exactly where it is.

li.label: a smell of spoiling food
li.description: Something in there is going off, and the flies have already moved in.

li.label: no room to turn around
li.description: There's barely space to stand up where I sleep. I bang my shin on something every morning.

li.label: a machine droning by my bed
li.description: That machine never stops. I can feel it in my teeth when I try to sleep.

li.label: a smoky room
li.description: The fire fills that small room with smoke. My eyes are still stinging.

li.label: a long walk to the table
li.description: My bed is at one end of the colony and the table is at the other. I'm starving before I get there.

li.label: bitten by insects
li.description: This place breeds mosquitoes by the cloud, and every one of them has found me.

li.label: stepped in animal filth
li.description: I stepped right in it. Somebody should be cleaning up after the animals.

li.label: things lying everywhere
li.description: Nothing's where it should be. I spent the morning looking for things and tripping over others.

li.label: shoddy clothes
li.description: Whoever made these was in a hurry. They pinch, they itch, and they come apart at the seams.

li.label: slept on something hard
li.description: I could feel every lump in the floor through it. My back hasn't forgiven me yet.
